mapper.update: ALTER TABLE `${table}` REORGANIZE PARTITION pmax INTO ( PARTITION `${partition}` VALUES LESS THAN ('${boundary}'), PARTITION pmax VALUES LESS THAN (MAXVALUE) )
mapper.select: SELECT PARTITION_NAME AS name, PARTITION_DESCRIPTION AS boundary, TABLE_ROWS AS rowCount FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = #{table} AND PARTITION_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PARTITION_ORDINAL_POSITION
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_archive_log (table_name, partition_name, action, boundary_time, row_count, result, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{tableName}, #{partitionName}, #{action}, #{boundaryTime}, #{rowCount}, #{result}, #{remark}, NOW())
